summary: Allow exporting the dataset manifest as CSV from the dataset page
problem: Users copy dataset manifests by hand into spreadsheets for audits.
goal: One-click CSV export of the manifest currently shown.
proposed_change: Add an Export CSV action on the dataset page that downloads the visible manifest with the same columns and filters.
acceptance: Export CSV button visible on the dataset page
Downloaded file matches the visible rows and columns
Filters applied on screen are respected
where_to_test: Dataset page with an active filter
what_to_test: Row count matches the filtered table
